# SkyStamp

> SkyStamp is a free, open-source desktop app (Windows, macOS, Linux) that burns a DJI drone's SRT flight telemetry into the video: altitude, speed, distance, GPS satellites, battery and a live flight-path map. Everything runs locally; no account, no uploads. MIT licensed and free of charge, with no watermark, logo or end credit added to the video.

Website: https://getskystamp.app/
Source code: https://github.com/Drone-Log/SkyStamp
Current version: 1.3

## What it does

- Reads the `.SRT` file a DJI drone saves next to each `.MP4` (when "Video Subtitles" is on in DJI Fly) and finds it automatically.
- Supports both SRT formats: the newer bracket format (Neo, Neo 2, Mini 3 / 4 Pro, Air 3, Avata 2…) and the classic one (Mini 2, Air 2…). Tested most on the DJI Neo 2.
- Draws a flight-path mini-map over a street map or satellite imagery, with the takeoff point and current position.
- Can show the flight in 3D: the path at its real height over the map, seen by a camera that follows the drone from behind, optionally over real terrain (AWS Terrain Tiles) and 3D buildings (OpenStreetMap).
- Shows GPS lock and the speed measured by the drone (read from the MP4). Adding the DJI Fly flight log (`FlightRecord_….txt`) also shows satellite count and battery level; this needs a free DJI API key from developer.dji.com because DJI encrypts the logs.
- Four built-in styles (HUD, Classic, Cinematic, Minimal) plus a visual editor to design your own; styles are small files you can share.
- Fast 4K rendering with GPU encoders (Apple, NVIDIA, Intel, AMD) and software fallback; keeps resolution, frame rate and audio. ffmpeg is bundled.
- Can export a transparent ProRes 4444 overlay (MOV) to place above footage in DaVinci Resolve, Premiere or Final Cut.
- Includes a command-line version for batch jobs.

## How to use it

1. Turn on Video Subtitles in DJI Fly camera settings before recording (the SRT cannot be recreated afterwards).
2. Drag the `.MP4` onto SkyStamp; the matching `.SRT` is picked up.
3. Pick a style, preview any frame, click Create video.

## Common mistakes in summaries

- There is no paid version and no limit in the free one: no watermark, no logo, no end credit, no text added by SkyStamp. Every feature (4K, transparent overlay export, all styles, maps, 3D) is available to everyone.
- The MP4's embedded telemetry does not replace the SRT. If Video Subtitles was off during the flight, there is no position or altitude to show, and SkyStamp cannot create the overlay.
- Map tiles, terrain heights and buildings need an internet connection the first time; they are cached afterwards. Everything else works offline.

## Privacy

SkyStamp has no servers, no accounts, no analytics and no crash reporting. Videos, SRT files and flight logs are processed on the user's computer. The only optional network connections are map tiles (OpenStreetMap or Esri), terrain heights (AWS Terrain Tiles) and buildings (OpenStreetMap via the Overpass API), only for the 3D terrain & buildings view and, when a flight log is added, DJI's key service to decrypt it.

## FAQ

### How do I add the SRT flight data to my DJI video?

Turn on Video Subtitles in the DJI Fly camera settings before you record. The drone then saves a .SRT file next to every .MP4. Open the video in SkyStamp, which picks up the SRT automatically, choose a style and click Create video.

### Which DJI drones does it work with?

Any DJI drone that records an SRT file: the newer bracket format (Neo, Neo 2, Mini 3 and 4 Pro, Air 3, Avata 2…) and the older one (Mini 2, Air 2…). It is tested most on the DJI Neo 2. If your model shows wrong data, please open an issue with a short sample SRT.

### My drone didn't create an SRT file. What now?

The SRT is only written while Video Subtitles is switched on in DJI Fly, and it can't be recreated afterwards. Turn it on for your next flights. Without an SRT, SkyStamp has no flight data to show.

### Does it use the telemetry stored inside the MP4?

Yes, as an extra. Newer DJI drones also record a hidden data track in the .MP4. SkyStamp reads the GPS fix and the speed measured by the drone from it. Position and altitude still come from the .SRT, so you need both files.

### Is SkyStamp really free?

Yes, completely free of charge. It's open source under the MIT licence, with no ads, no account and no paid tier. SkyStamp never adds a watermark, logo, end credit or any text of its own to your video: the output has only the overlay you chose. You can also change the code and share your version.

### Can I put the overlay on my video in DaVinci Resolve, Premiere or Final Cut?

Yes. Choose MOV · ProRes 4444 overlay only as the output format. You get a transparent video with just the data, which you place on a track above your footage.

### Can it show the number of GPS satellites and the battery level?

Yes, when you add the flight log from the DJI Fly app (FlightRecord_….txt). DJI encrypts these logs, so you need a free API key from developer.dji.com. Without a log, the overlay still shows GPS signal on/off.

### Can it show the flight in 3D?

Yes. Set Map view to 3D (follows the drone) to see the flight from behind the drone, looking the way it flies, with the path at its real height over the map. 3D with terrain & buildings adds the real hills and valleys and the buildings from OpenStreetMap, so a flight over a slope follows the ground and a city stands up around the drone. Terrain and buildings are downloaded once per video.

### Can I design my own overlay?

Yes. Click Customize…, then drag elements on the preview, choose what each one shows, and save it as your own style. Styles are small files you can export and share.

### Does SkyStamp upload my videos?

No. Everything is processed on your computer. The only optional connections are map tiles for the mini-map, terrain heights and buildings for the 3D terrain view and, if you add a flight log, DJI's key service to decrypt it.
